shared_notes: Overpass (overpass-api.de and mirrors) was unreachable in this session, so resolve-pin.py ran on Photon/Wikipedia/Commons only and reported LOW or nothing for most; points below come from Photon/Nominatim OSM features (feature type given) cross-checked with a second source where one exists.

Overpass was down, so resolve-pin.py gave LOW for the pins asked about; every pin here is traced to a named OSM feature or a second source and its type is in coordinates_source. Mudgee Wine Region is the one pin held.
Prices were read from operator pages on 18 Oct 2026; NPWS parks show no entry fee, so free is inferred and camping is extra.

Kanangra-Boyd National Park itself is not researched as a spot (Kanangra Walls and Jenolan Caves cover the fallback). Pantoneys Crown, Megalong Valley, Everglades Gardens and the Cowra war cemeteries stay in review.

facts.claim: 6 km return, Grade 3 walk from the carpark at the end of Glowworm Tunnel Road to the tunnel; NPWS text says 1.5 km to the entrance (Wikivoyage says 1 km), so the bio should not quote one number.
Tunnel is 387 m long, built early 1900s for the Wolgan Valley railway. Wollemi NP 'always open but may close for weather or fire'.

Road is unsealed gravel (State Mine Gully Road to Glowworm Tunnel Road): 2WD possible in dry weather, 4WD highly recommended, 4WD only in wet weather. Tunnel-to-Newnes section may close after heavy rain.

Alerts reviewed 19 Oct 2026: State Mine Gully Road closed 19-23 Oct 2026 for roadworks; Bungleboori site closed to visitors for construction until December 2026 with single-lane traffic on Glowworm Tunnel Road from 11 Oct; park fire ban 1 Oct 2026-31 Mar 2027.
